waypoints.name: Mt. Thielsen Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From the junction of OR 138 and OR 230 near Diamond Lake, drive OR 138 north about 1.5 miles to the Mount Thielsen Trailhead and Sno-Park on the east side of the highway. A Northwest Forest Pass or day-use fee is required to park, and an Oregon Sno-Park permit from November through April.

waypoints.name: Mount Thielsen
waypoints.directions: Follow the Mount Thielsen Trail east through lodgepole pine, passing the Spruce Ridge Trail junction, to its crossing of the Pacific Crest Trail. Keep climbing the west ridge on the unmarked climbers' path above timberline, over loose pumice and scree, to the base of the summit spire, then make the short, steep, exposed hand-over-hand climb to the top.
